summary.headline: Powers of the Fixed Stars
summary.text: Discussion of the powers and epochs of fixed stars, attributed possibly to Julian of Laodicea and dated to the reign of Diocletian. A list gives the longitudes, latitudes, magnitudes, and Venus–Mercury mixtures of Spica, stars of Lyra, Aquarius’s southern Fish, the Bird, and the Crown, followed by their effects on nativities.
